---
title: Fish Velouté
id: MAR-0115
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 60
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 1.2 kg of rock fish (tub gurnard, scorpionfish, red mullet, stargazer...)
- 200 g of tomato sauce
- 1 onion
- 1 carrot
- 0.5 celery stalk
- 4 slices of country bread
- 1 garlic clove
- 6 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Clean the fish, cutting the larger specimens into steaks.
2. Peel the onion and dice it.
3. Scrape the carrot under running water and cut it first into sticks lengthwise, then into small pieces; clean the celery stalk of strings and slice it thinly.
4. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a saucepan and let the vegetables wilt for 5 minutes.
5. Salt, moisten with a little water and cook for 20 minutes, then add the tomato sauce and two ladles of water.
6. Add the fish and cook for a few minutes.
7. As it begins to flake, drain it, bone it, pass it through a sieve and add it back to the tomato, thinning with more water if the preparation is too thick; adjust the salt.
8. Toast the bread slices in the oven at 220 °C for 5 minutes, rub them with garlic, place them in deep plates, oil them with the remaining oil (they should be well seasoned), pour the velouté over them and serve.
